premises.text: Bugs, missing features, and hard-to-get support characterize open and free software
premises.evidence_span: bugs and missing features. And especially when it's open or free software, support can be hard to get

premises.text: Users and developers differ in knowledge and priorities, blocking support
premises.evidence_span: mismatch in knowledge and priority between the user and the developer

premises.text: A service lets users pay or get paid for support directly from an issue page
premises.evidence_span: offering a service which allows you to pay or get paid directly from an issue page

premises.text: Major issue trackers get an integrated incentive panel with crowdfunding and developer ask flows
premises.evidence_span: we offer integrations for all the major issue systems, like Mantis, Jira, Track, and Bugzilla

premises.text: Monetization is a 6% take plus fee-share that turns hosters' issue systems into profit centers
premises.evidence_span: we take a 6% fee for each successful incentive. And we offer a fee to all the issue system hosters running our integration, which turns an issue system into a profit center

value.text: Get the software support or improvements you need via paid incentives
value.evidence_span: get the support you really need or where it's easy to get something improved

secondary_value.text: Monetization layer for the open source market
secondary_value.evidence_span: adding a monetization element to the entire open source market

causal_links.evidence_span: support can be hard to get

notes: Panel UI details and crowdfunding clicks folded into the integration premise. Intention to put the panel on every bug page treated as vision (§4.1(4)), not coded. Singleton fee domain kept as independently revisable commercial module.

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.2; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
